name: BIT-LIFE iGEM 2026 Promoter Engineering 1.0.0
description: Companion research resources for the BIT-LIFE iGEM 2026 Promoter Engineering software, version 1.0.0. Includes the 35 bp CNN-Transformer Hybrid seed42 checkpoint, CNN/random-forest comparison checkpoints, the processed L4 table, fixed benchmark splits, source code, installation documentation and SHA-256 checksums. The 112,955 experimental measurements originate from Zhou et al. (2025), Deep learning guided programmable design of Escherichia coli core promoters from sequence architecture to strength control, Nucleic Acids Research 53(16), gkaf863, doi:10.1093/nar/gkaf863, Supplementary Table S5. They are not new measurements by this team. The processed table retains three available biological replicates per sequence; strength is their mean. The fixed split contains 79,069 training, 16,943 validation and 16,943 test sequences with no exact overlap. Labels use library-wide log2-minmax normalization. Hybrid test metrics reproduced on CPU are R2 0.5684211, RMSE 0.0906544, MAE 0.0675100, Pearson r 0.7563676 and Spearman rho 0.7011364. These are regression statistics, not classification accuracy or new wet-lab measurements. Mutation analyses are exploratory model-score comparisons. Licenses apply by material, not as alternative choices: original project software and accompanying project artifacts retain MIT licensing; experimental measurements and derived benchmark data preserve the original publication's CC BY-NC 4.0 conditions.
